title: Robots Cheaper Than Cars
script: What happens if a household robot costs less than a car? Humanoid robots have already been deployed in commercial logistics. A home is a much messier problem. Imagine carrying groceries, moving laundry, and cleaning under the table as ordinary appliance features. The sales pitch is saved time. The real test is whether you trust it around your family. And who fixes it when a software update changes how it behaves? Would you choose a robot or a second car?

Facts must be separately sourced; use a small persistent POSSIBLE FUTURE label, never a news-like breaking banner.

protocol: Produce original story assets, review factual grounding, verify every future claim is conditional or explicitly fictional, then inspect continuity and safe zones. No real-world experiment outcome is claimed.
evidenceRequirements: Verify actual deployments; no invented future price or claimed consumer availability.
